name: Affine-Invariant Clustering
definition: A clustering scheme invariant under affine transformations (translation, rotation, uniform scaling, and shear) by transforming points into a PCA-based coordinate system.
summary: Affine-Invariant Clustering is a clustering scheme invariant under affine transformations, including shear, by transforming points into a PCA-based coordinate system, distinguishing it from standard PCA-based clustering which lacks shear invariance.
